question_record.context: Recently, there was an incident reported where a user clicked on a potentially malicious URL via the email address `bjenkins@niseko.alpineskihouse.co`. Earlier, suspicious remote activity was observed on the machine which involved potentially malicious actions. Additionally, the machine was scanned or dumped memory from the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (lsass.exe) allowing extraction of sensitive credentials.
question_record.question: Can you find the email address associated with the account that created the suspicious service DDLOXJDSQSNGMUKKFUXQ on MB-ADFS?
solution: The user with AadUserId `a2d0f7c2-b0a0-43bd-bce0-27d8ae3be4d0` clicked on a potentially malicious URL.
The process `powershell.exe` was used to scan or dump memory from the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (lsass.exe) to extract sensitive credentials.
Suspicious remote activity was observed on the machine and initiated by the user with AadUserId `ec3ec68b-fdeb-4fe4-9a29-acd445e1ccc5`.
The user `gsmith` with email `gsmith@niseko.alpineskihouse.co` created a suspicious service DDLOXJDSQSNGMUKKFUXQ on MB-ADFS to potentially execute malicious commands.

104.name: A potentially malicious URL click was detected
104.description: We have detected that one of your users has recently clicked on a link that was found to be malicious. -V1.0.0.5

67.name: Sensitive credential memory read
67.description: A process scanned or dumped memory from the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (lsass.exe).  Accessing this process memory allows the attacker to extract secrets such as authentication hashes or passwords.  A copy of this memory may be written to the file system and exfiltrated to extract these credentials offline.

37.name: Suspicious remote activity
37.description: Suspicious activity initiated remotely was observed on this machine. This alert can flag attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, and other potentially malicious activities from a remote machine.

101.name: Suspicious service creation
101.description: gsmith created DDLOXJDSQSNGMUKKFUXQ in order to execute potentially malicious commands on MB-ADFS.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_Derived_Email' AND o.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
